title: Missing raw data can fall back to a normalized score
what_changed: Code path removed: a missing measurement shows "no measured value"; the 0-100 index is shown only as "index n of 100 (a relative score, not a measurement)". Not reproduced on the live sample, fixed at source.

after_2.9.0: PASS no figure shows a 0-100 score in place of a missing measured value (327 rows checked)

what_changed: Groups open closed and "Score and ranking" is down to about 15 rows; a purpose-specific "Relevant facts" first view is not built yet.

what_changed: Language-area leaders outside the top 10 show their rank inside the language area (for example "FR 1") and the tooltip gives both ranks with the denominator.

title: Parameter colours and profile-rank labels can describe different things
what_changed: With a parameter layer active, every pin says it is a profile rank, not the coloured parameter. A legend with units is still open.

title: Add an explicit lowest-fit map view
what_changed: No lowest-fit map view yet.

what_changed: Household and business are one app with separate profiles and shortlists since 2.7; DINKS -> Business -> Places to live returns to DINKS (test).

title: Business data is not aligned with the residential market roster
what_changed: Business page (16 Oct beta) country scope not re-examined in this stage.

title: Industry-and-energy screen is US-specific
what_changed: The business page's industry and energy screen is US states only; non-US business cost context is not integrated.

title: Business operating models need actual ranking contracts
what_changed: Seven business profiles with their own weights and must-haves rank municipalities in the app since 2.7 (tests v27/R-suite). Owner review of the weights is still pending.

title: First-visit introduction reportedly disappeared
what_changed: First-visit introduction on the live origin not re-tested in this stage.

title: First visit exposes a large profile and country menu
what_changed: Start page asks Places to live or Business, then offers 6 household chips plus "More households" and one country selector (screenshots, v26 tests).

title: DINKS default hard filters leave only ten Swiss places
what_changed: Presets with hard minimums still apply them before showing the remaining count; the "why not" explanation is kept.

title: Country-normalized fit scores are not global utilities
what_changed: 2.8 separates measures compared across countries (pool) from within-country ones; cross-country comparison warns that scores are country-relative. No global sort of country-relative scores was added.

title: National context must not become thousands of municipal observations
what_changed: National figures are stored once per country (2.8 regional tables) and never count as measured local data: categories backed only by a national figure are labelled estimates and are excluded from "measured".

title: Proxy factors need explicit caveats and correlation control
what_changed: Each stand-in category names what it is estimated from on the place page and counts half. A full proxy register with formulas is still open.

title: Confidence can be mistaken for a probability
what_changed: The evidence shares now say they are not a probability; the "source confidence" percentage is still shown with its explanation.

title: Energy prices require compatible cost cohorts
what_changed: Tariff data from the 16-18 Oct global package was not delivered to this build (the ZIP did not arrive).

title: An energy index is useful only with its denominator
what_changed: B-READY / energy index data not ingested in this build.

title: Two Iceland water-cost values must be quarantined
what_changed: Iceland B-READY water values not ingested; nothing to quarantine in this build.

title: Chart-read electricity values need visible approximation
what_changed: Chart-read Eurostat electricity values not ingested.

title: Property and gender-rights indices have limited legal scope
what_changed: B-READY / WBL legal indices not ingested.

title: Index components can overwhelm rankings
what_changed: WBL / B-READY / HDR component families not ingested.

title: Missing, uncollected and unavailable are different states
what_changed: Missing stays missing in scoring and display; the business page now separates unknown, invalid and zero. Typed source-missing / not-captured / suppressed states for the new package are not applicable until it is ingested.

title: Release dates and observation years differ
what_changed: Every 2.8 measure shows its own period per country; separate edition and last-checked dates are not shown.

title: Source-area energy quotes are not country averages
what_changed: Source-area energy quotes not ingested.

title: Keep aliases and geographic hierarchy explicit
what_changed: EL/GR and UK/GB are mapped explicitly in the data sync and the business page; joins use official IDs (test_v28 golden values).

title: Mobile business entry is dominated by metadata cards
what_changed: Business page at 390 px not re-examined in this stage.

title: Business screening stops short of premises and operating feasibility
what_changed: Site feasibility statuses beyond the existing unresolved checklist not added.

title: Founder interview needs business-purpose context
what_changed: Business founder copy awaits owner approval of the proposed text.

title: State migration and offline operation need current-origin testing
what_changed: Real-origin storage migration and offline reopen not tested in this stage.

title: Map failure, slow responses and empty results need useful fallbacks
what_changed: Map failure fallback not re-tested in this stage.

title: Accessibility requires interaction-level checks
what_changed: Search and the phone filter sheet now contain focus and restore it (050); broader keyboard and screen-reader audit open.

title: Performance claims need the deployed asset graph
what_changed: Start page 119 KB compressed, country data loaded per country, measured in the regression suite (R30).

title: A public index is not automatically licensed for commercial redistribution
what_changed: Non-commercial sources (WHO GHO, WorldClim) are excluded at sync; every measure names its source and licence. Italian OMI terms flagged to the owner.

title: Product counts and claims need one manifest
what_changed: One manifest for all counts not built yet.

title: NASA climate payload and Ireland completeness remain open
what_changed: NASA climate payload and complete Ireland data still missing.

title: Relocation needs household eligibility and actual lived costs
what_changed: Household eligibility and lived-cost checklist not built.

title: Business costs require scenario inputs beyond tax indices
what_changed: Business tax scenario inputs not built.

title: Tests must distinguish data helpers from repaired website behavior
what_changed: This ledger: every ID with a status, before (live 2.8.1) and after (2.9.0) browser evidence for each repaired defect.

title: Consent and network disclosures must survive new data loaders
what_changed: No analytics or ads before consent (regression R23, R69); no new client-side data loaders were added.

title: Location shortlist needs an evidence export, not just a rank
what_changed: Evidence export for a shortlist not built (CSV per place and comparison PDF exist).

what_changed: Fine-tuned weights are kept with the profile and restored when the builder reopens; changing an answer says so before replacing them; a separate reset is offered.
